if (typeof v !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(v)) return this.fail(name, 'must be a whole number');

findings.text: CO-3 reads weekday with Fields.int, but Fields.int rejects any non-number and req.query values are strings, so every valid weekday (e.g. "6") would fail 400 'must be a whole number'. The existing id filters parse with Number() instead.

findings.text: Q-03 (A-05) asked which parameter carries the weekday, though req.md already left it to design with a default of the existing filter keys and the stored 1..7 coding, which the migration fixes.
